006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAtomicValuedItem;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IArrayItem;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapItem;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
014
015import org.eclipse.jdt.annotation.Owning;
016
017import java.io.PrintWriter;
018
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020
021/**
022 * Produces a textual representation of a Metapath sequence.
023 */
024public class DefaultItemWriter implements IItemWriter {
025
026  @Owning
027  @NonNull
028  private final PrintWriter writer;
029  @NonNull
030  private final Visitor visitor = new Visitor();
031
032  /**
033   * Construct a new item writer.
034   *
035   * @param writer
036   *          the writer to append text to
037   */
038  public DefaultItemWriter(@NonNull PrintWriter writer) {
039    this.writer = writer;
040  }
041
042  @Override
043  public void writeSequence(ISequence<?> sequence) {
044    boolean wrap = sequence.size() != 1;
045    if (wrap) {
046      writer.append('(');
047    }
048
049    boolean first = true;
050    for (IItem item : sequence) {
051
052      if (first) {
053        first = false;
054      } else {
055        writer.append(',');
056      }
057
058      item.accept(visitor);
059    }
060
061    if (wrap) {
062      writer.append(')');
063    }
064  }
065
066  @Override
067  public void writeArray(IArrayItem<?> array) {
068    writer.append('[');
069    boolean first = true;
070    for (ICollectionValue value : array) {
071      assert value != null;
072
073      if (first) {
074        first = false;
075      } else {
076        writer.append(',');
077      }
078
079      writeCollectionValue(value);
080    }
081    writer.append(']');
082  }
083
084  @Override
085  public void writeMap(IMapItem<?> map) {
086    writer.append("map {");
087    boolean first = true;
088    for (ICollectionValue value : map.values()) {
089      assert value != null;
090
091      if (first) {
092        first = false;
093      } else {
094        writer.append(',');
095      }
096
097      writeCollectionValue(value);
098    }
099    writer.append('}');
100  }
101
102  @Override
103  public void writeNode(INodeItem node) {
104    writer.append(node.getBaseUri().toString());
105    writer.append('#');
106    writer.append(node.getMetapath());
107
108    if (node instanceof IAtomicValuedItem) {
109      writer.append('<');
110      writer.append(node.toAtomicItem().asString());
111      writer.append('>');
112    }
113  }
114
115  @Override
116  public void writeAtomicValue(IAnyAtomicItem node) {
117    writer.append(node.asString());
118  }
119
120  @Override
121  public void writeFunction(IFunction function) {
122    writer.append(function.toSignature());
123  }
124
125  /**
126   * Write the provided collection value.
127   *
128   * @param value
129   *          the value to write
130   */
131  protected void writeCollectionValue(@NonNull ICollectionValue value) {
132    if (value instanceof IItem) {
133      ((IItem) value).accept(visitor);
134    } else if (value instanceof ISequence) {
135      writeSequence((ISequence<?>) value);
136    }
137  }
138
139  @Override
140  public void close() {
141    writer.close();
142  }
143
144  private final class Visitor implements IItemVisitor {
145
146    @Override
147    public void visit(IArrayItem<?> array) {
148      writeArray(array);
149    }
150
151    @Override
152    public void visit(IMapItem<?> map) {
153      writeMap(map);
154    }
155
156    @Override
157    public void visit(INodeItem node) {
158      writeNode(node);
159    }
160
161    @Override
162    public void visit(IAnyAtomicItem node) {
163      writeAtomicValue(node);
164    }
165
166    @Override
167    public void visit(IFunction function) {
168      writeFunction(function);
169    }
170  }
171}
